meta.title: 梁辰
meta.description: Shows whether DeepSeek API pricing is currently in its peak or off-peak window. The badge sits above the sidebar account button or at the right of the titlebar, and its text and color are configurable in Settings > 梁辰. Peak/off-peak hours are synced from the DeepSeek API pricing page at startup; the settings page also offers a 24-hour timeline, manual intervals, and a one-day override. Hover or focus the badge for a countdown to the next peak/off-peak switch. Chinese public holidays sync automatically, with a manual holiday calendar and custom SVG icon import. Sidebar width syncs every 30 minutes with adaptive wrapping. Supports silent, badge-dot, and manual update modes, checking npm, npmmirror, and jsDelivr in order at startup.
